title: Rav Tachlifa, Father of Rav Huna bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yoma 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.6b.4) and [Keritot 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.25b.19), speaking in the name of Rava. Hyman explains that they called him after his son because his son’s name was better known.[^1]

notes.text: Both passages explicitly call him Rav Tachlifa, father of Rav Huna, and transmit teachings in the name of Rava. The reason for using the son’s name is Hyman’s explanation.
